general.enabledDesc: Refresh the wallpaper at midnight with the next city.
general.autostartDesc: Start InkCity automatically when you log in.
general.hideTrayDescOn: With the tray hidden, relaunch the app to reopen this window.

about.p1: InkCity sets your desktop wallpaper to a road map of a different city every day. The city for each day is picked deterministically from a list of the world's 1,000 most populous cities, so everyone running InkCity sees the same city on the same day.
about.p2: Road geometry is fetched from OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API and rendered locally. Cached data is kept for 7 days under your app cache directory.
about.feedbackDesc: Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub. Please include your OS version and, if relevant, the city / date that triggered the problem.
